components.capability: Reports have run_id, contract/runtime/gate metadata and safe writing, but no generic immutable EvalRun registry or identity conflict handling.
components.reuse_action: Extend existing report identity/hash conventions through one Eval-only registry; do not reuse production tables.
components.new_work_required: Generic run contract, identity hash, immutable file record, idempotent create/load.
components.risk: Mutable or aggregate-only run records make historical comparisons ambiguous; identity mismatch must fail closed.

components.capability: Artifact writers/readers and sanitation preserve exact inputs, hashes, run identity and bounded safe output.
components.reuse_action: Reuse byte/hash and safe artifact conventions; add a generic manifest wrapper only in Eval space.
components.new_work_required: Common ArtifactSnapshot shape and deterministic manifest hash.
components.risk: Duplicated source/provider payloads can expose sensitive text or create hash drift; keep large evidence in existing artifacts.

components.capability: SourceLocationResolver resolves refs/hashes; traceability-service covers requirement/section; P0 artifacts contain 487-atom mechanical evidence.
components.reuse_action: Add generic ordered stages and a Requirement adapter consuming these APIs and prior artifacts; never rebuild Provider evidence.
components.new_work_required: Generic TraceStage, evidence-gap marker, first mechanical divergence and adapter indexer.
components.risk: Missing historical payload must remain an evidence gap, not a semantic miss or regenerated Provider call.

components.capability: Existing evaluators validate envelopes, source spans, hashes, duplicates, replay determinism and mutation sensitivity.
components.reuse_action: Adapt deterministic check interfaces while keeping current module evaluators intact.
components.new_work_required: Unified check IDs, observation schema, risk-signal collection and first-divergence calculation.

components.capability: Attribution and quality reports carry case-level classifications and evidence, but no reusable lifecycle/idempotent registry with nullable semantic labels.
components.reuse_action: Reuse case-level ledger/checkpoint conventions; implement one generic Eval-only registry.
components.new_work_required: BadCase lifecycle, label provenance validation, evidence refs and frozen-ledger importer.
components.risk: Aggregate counts or Codex-inferred labels would contaminate Gold; absent exact 44-row ledger stays SEED_LEDGER_INPUT_PENDING_GPT.

components.capability: Results include per-case failure_family fields, but no versioned family definitions or membership registry.
components.reuse_action: Reuse result/version conventions; add versioned Eval-only definitions and membership.
components.new_work_required: Family lifecycle, owner/status and idempotent membership.
components.risk: Example family names are schema examples, not current diagnoses.

components.capability: Runners execute targeted, replay, quality-gate and holdout comparisons with per-case artifacts.
components.reuse_action: Wrap current runners behind explicit scope/partition identity and preserve per-check outcomes.
components.new_work_required: RegressionResult shape, baseline/current identity checks and Core6-versus-Holdout guard.
components.risk: Core6 development cases must not be reported as an independent fresh holdout.

components.capability: Production extraction, source resolution, canonical projection and exports expose required stage identities.
components.reuse_action: Create only a typed adapter at the tracer boundary; no second extractor or canonicalizer.
components.new_work_required: Tender Source→Section→Chunk→Provider Input→Raw Candidate→Normalization→Source Resolution→Canonical Requirement mapping.
components.risk: Adapter must preserve production run/source identity and mark absent evidence rather than fill it.

components.capability: Many module-specific Node ESM runners exist, but no single flywheel entrypoint.
components.reuse_action: Add one eval:flywheel script delegating to one runner; no second CLI framework.
components.new_work_required: trace, evaluate, import-badcases, regression and summary subcommands with safe fixture root.
components.risk: CLI must not write production tables, call Provider or silently mix datasets.

components.capability: Production/domain persistence is extensive, but dedicated eval_runs/eval_cases/bad_cases/failure_families/regression_results tables were not found.
components.reuse_action: Use file-first immutable artifacts for V1; no migration in this Decision. Revisit one bounded Eval migration only after a separate decision proves query need.
components.new_work_required: Storage adapter over artifact directories and an optional future DB adapter.
components.risk: Reusing production authority tables for Eval rows could mutate or confuse business truth.

existing_eval_components.role: Source, duplicate, replay and mutation quality audit
Runtime identity, smoke and artifact recovery orchestration
Production-shaped runtime identity and provenance capture
Deterministic full-corpus comparison and manifest conventions
Gold governance and review packet conventions

runtime_lineage_components.role: Canonical Requirement provider input and envelope validation
Source span and source hash resolution
Ordered production generation state audit; not a generic Eval registry
Production repository access; read-only references for flywheel
Safe report sanitation and artifact writing

persistence_observations.v1_decision: File-first Eval artifacts; production tables are read-only authority and are not Eval registry storage.

artifact_conventions.safe_logging: Reuse requirement-extraction-report sanitizer; credentials, prompts, raw provider content and unbounded source fields are not written to registry records.

estimates.estimate_basis: Ten TDD tasks in the accompanying plan; counts are planning estimates, not current files.
